message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for **Canada** in 2023.  
A *long weekend* here means at least three consecutive non‑working days created by a statutory holiday (or an observance that shifts the holiday to a nearby weekday).

| # | Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---|---------|--------|-------|
| 1 | **Jan 1–Feb 2** | New Year’s Day (Sun Jan 1 → observed Mon Jan 2) | Two‑day break plus the following Monday. |
| 2 | **Feb 19–21** | Family Day (Mon Feb 20) | Third Monday in February (BC has St. Patrick’s Day instead). |
| 3 | **Mar 29–Apr 2** | Good Friday (Fri Mar 31) + Easter Monday (Mon Apr 7) | A four‑day stretch in most provinces. |
| 4 | **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (Mon May 22) | Last Monday in May. |
| 5 | **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (Sat Jul 1 → observed Mon Jul 3) | Weekend plus the following Monday. |
| 6 | **Aug 12–14** | Civic Holiday (Mon Aug 14) | First Monday in August (varies by province). |
| 7 | **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (Mon Sep 4) | First Monday in September. |
| 8 | **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (Mon Oct 9) | Second Monday in October. |
| 9 | **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day (Mon Dec 25) | Weekend plus the following Monday. |

> **Quick reference:**  
> • **Long weekends involving two holidays** (e.g., Good Friday + Easter Monday) give a *four‑day* break.  
> • All other entries represent a standard *three‑day* break (sat‑sun‑mon).

Feel free to plug these dates directly into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific variations (like BC’s Family Day vs. St. Patrick’s Day, or Quebec’s unique holidays), let me know and I’ll add those details.
message.reasoning:
The user wants "list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023". They want data about Canadian public holidays that create long weekends (i.e., holidays falling on Friday or Monday). We can provide them.

We don't have direct tool to fetch from an API; we might use web search but no browsing allowed. But we can recall known Canadian federal holidays:

In Canada, there are several statutory holidays:
New Year's Day – Jan 1
Family Day – third Monday in February (except BC)
Good Friday – variable
Easter Monday – not a bank holiday except some provinces
Victoria Day – last Monday in May
Canada Day – July 1
Civic Holiday – first Monday in August (some provinces)
Labour Day – first Monday in September
Thanksgiving – second Monday in October
Remembrance Day – Nov 11 (not always observed as holiday)
Christmas Day – Dec 25
Boxing Day – Dec 26

But long weekends typically include Good Friday + Easter Monday (but only in certain provinces), Victoria Day, Canada Day (if falls on weekday?), Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas/Boxing day etc.

However question likely expects list of dates where there's a long weekend due to national holidays. For each province maybe different. Might just give general list of federal holidays that result in long weekends across all provinces.

Let's compile list for 2023:

January 1 - New Year’s Day (Sunday) -> Observed Monday Jan 2? Actually many provinces observe next working day. So long weekend Sunday-January 1 plus Monday Jan 2. That's considered long weekend.

February 20 - Family Day (third Monday Feb 20) -> Long weekend Saturday-Feb 18 to Monday-Feb 20.

March 31 - Good Friday (Friday March 31) -> Long weekend Fri-Mar 31 to Sun-Apr 2.

April 7 - Easter Monday (Monday Apr 7) -> Not a federal holiday but provincial.

May 22 - Victoria Day (last Monday in May) -> Long weekend Sat-May 20-Mon-May 22.

July 1 - Canada Day (Saturday Jul 1) -> Observed Monday Jul 3? Many provinces shift. So long weekend Sat-Jul 1-Sun-Jul 2 with Mon Jul 3.

August 14 - Civic Holiday (first Monday Aug 14) -> Long weekend Sat-Aug 12-Mon Aug 14.

September 4 - Labour Day (Mon Sep 4) -> Long weekend Sat-Sept 2-Mon Sept 4.

October 9 - Thanksgiving (second Monday Oct 9) -> Long weekend Sat-Oct 7-Mon Oct 9.

November 10 - Remembrance Day (observed Thursday?) In most provinces it's observed on Thursday November 10 because Nov 11 is Veterans Day. That doesn't make long weekend.

December 25 - Christmas Day (Monday Dec 25) -> Long weekend Sat-Dec 23-Mon Dec 25.

December 27 - Boxing Day (Wednesday Dec 27) -> No long weekend.

Also December 24 & 31 may be observed days.

Thus list of long weekends: Jan 1-2, Feb 19-21, Mar 29-Apr 2, May 20-22, Jul 1-3, Aug 12-14, Sep 2-4, Oct 7-9, Dec 23-25.
